events.event: The government and Danantara said PT Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia (DSI) will be the single intermediary for coal, CPO and ferro alloy exports from 1 January 2027, via its NADI data portal, without buying or selling the goods.
events.key_numbers: Start 1 Jan 2027 · NADI technical briefing 15 Nov 2026 · account registration opens 15 Dec 2026 · trial with 100 exporters covering ~50% of export value of these commodities · 340 contracts uploaded in test · DSI authorised capital Rp4 trillion (detik headline)
events.why_it_matters: Every coal and palm-oil export will pass through one Danantara entity, which worries exporters and investors about costs and control.
events.spreading_evidence: detik terpopuler #5; 5+ detik headlines on DSI on 6 Nov

events.event: Coordinating Minister Airlangga Hartarto signalled a fourth revision of the export-proceeds (DHE SDA) rule that would let exporters convert up to 100% of foreign-currency proceeds to rupiah, versus a 50% cap now.
events.key_numbers: Conversion cap 50% -> up to 100% · current retention: migas min 30% for 3 months, non-migas 100% for 12 months · conversion fell 37.4% per LNSW · conversion US$23.8bn (Jun-Aug 2025) -> US$14.9bn (Jun-Aug 2026) (articles print 'million', likely billion; unverified) · revision targeted end-Nov 2026 per Harian Jogja
events.why_it_matters: More exporter dollars turned into rupiah could support the weak rupiah (about Rp18,080/USD).

events.event: The IHSG recovered from an intraday drop of about 2% to close up 0.40% at 5,050.43 on Friday 6 November, led by BBRI, BMRI, BBCA, SMMA and ASII.
events.key_numbers: Close 5,050.43 (+20.17 pts, +0.40%) · low 4,925.10 · turnover Rp7.77T, 411.29M lots · financials sector +~2% · session-1 foreign net inflow Rp153.22bn (full-day figure not found) · laggards BRPT, EMAS, MDKA, TPIA, BRMS
events.why_it_matters: The index is back above 5,000 but still far below its pre-MSCI-warning level.

events.event: The rupiah closed at Rp18,080 per US dollar on 6 November, and Bank Indonesia said FX reserves rose to US$146.8 billion at end-October.
events.key_numbers: Rupiah Rp18,080 (-0.03% from Rp18,075) · intraday high Rp18,140 · DXY 101.939 (+0.39%) · reserves US$146.8bn (Oct) vs US$146.3bn (Sep) · cover 5.3 months of imports · rupiah ~+0.32% over the week to ~Rp18,089 (Mediakompeten)
events.why_it_matters: Reserves are a cushion, but the rupiah is stuck above Rp18,000 and a BI rate hike to 6% is being debated ahead of the 17-18 Nov RDG.

events.event: BPS reported August 2026 open unemployment fell to 4.75% (7.38 million people) even as layoffs (PHK) rose, with part-time work down and underemployment up.
events.key_numbers: TPT 4.75% · unemployed 7.38M (-77,000 yoy) · employed 147.99M (+1.44M) · TPAK 70.33% (from 70.59%) · underemployed 12.844M (+1.244M) · part-time 35.295M (-1.001M) · PHK Jan-Sep 2026 63,789 (headline, unverified)
events.why_it_matters: The headline number says jobs are fine, but many workers feel the opposite, so the data needs explaining.

events.event: OJK said the pledge of Haji Isam-linked shares (JARR, PGUN) to Bank Mandiri is allowed under banking rules, amid reports the loan funds a Bayan Resources (BYAN) share purchase.
events.key_numbers: 7,997,556,204 JARR shares pledged (100% of PT Eshan Agro Sentosa's stake), pledge dated 30 Sep 2026 · OJK cap: collateral up to 50% of share market value · loan amount not disclosed · borrower PT Jhonlin Baratama
events.why_it_matters: A state bank lending against a tycoon's shares to buy a coal giant raises questions of risk and oversight.

events.event: Bank Mandiri reported bank-only net profit of Rp46.5 trillion for January-October 2026, up 19.6% year on year, with NPL falling to 0.97%.
events.key_numbers: Net profit Rp46.5T (+19.6% yoy) · loans Rp1,635T (+16.5%) · gross NPL 0.97% (1.02% Oct 2025) · coverage 244.5% · cost of credit 0.55% · DPK Rp1,762T (+15.1%) · CASA ratio 71.8%
events.why_it_matters: Big banks are strong on fundamentals even while foreigners sell Indonesian stocks.

events.event: Bank Indonesia's November RDG on 17-18 Nov is widely expected by economists to raise the BI rate to 6% given rupiah pressure and capital outflows.
events.key_numbers: Expected BI rate 6% · RDG 17-18 Nov 2026 · rupiah ~Rp18,080/USD
events.why_it_matters: A rate hike would raise loan and mortgage costs for ordinary borrowers.
